artworks.title: Shed with Cottage
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high with a sky, clouds, birds, figures tending to sheep, thatched-roof structures, a stepped gable building, a wooden fence, and tall trees. The composition uses hatch marks for texture, linear techniques with fine lines and cross-hatching for shading, and a monochromatic color palette with various shades of grey.

artworks.title: Farm
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a pastoral scene with a rustic farmhouse as the central focus. The viewpoint captures the scene from a distance, showing a winding path leading towards the house. The horizon is positioned low, with bare trees lining it and scattered around the house. Sparse vegetation, livestock including sheep, and a figure walking nearby can be seen. The etching technique used for the artwork gives it a linear and detailed quality, emphasizing fine lines and textures. The monochromatic color palette is primarily black and white. In the distance, the sky shows two birds flying.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: This image depicts a rustic rural scene from a slightly elevated perspective. The landscape includes houses, people, and animals. The horizon is situated in the upper third of the image under a sky with swirling clouds. Thatched roofs of farmhouses and trees appear on the horizon. The artwork style resembles an etching or engraving with precise lines and hatching for shading. In the foreground, two women are shown, one carrying a basket and a jug, and the other holding a stick, surrounded by grazing cows. More cows are scattered across the landscape, with one near a small pond. On the left, there is a cluster of houses and trees forming a boundary, with small thatched-roof buildings in the distance. The color scheme is monochrome with black and sepia tones, giving the image a vintage look.

artworks.title: Farms and Shed
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with thatched-roof houses along a winding path. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. Trees and brush define the horizon. The etching technique creates texture and depth, seen in the rooftops and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, using varying shades of grey and beige. There are figures, including one seated and one standing, near the houses. Bare trees are both near and far. The sky is lightly etched with clouds.

artworks.title: Country Village with Post Mill
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural countryside landscape with a windmill, houses, trees, a path with figures, ducks in water, and birds flying. The scene is rendered in black and white ink, with detailed lines emphasizing contrast and texture.

artworks.title: Farm with Shed and Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after the Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural setting with two figures, a small dog, a dirt path leading to thatched-roof buildings surrounded by trees. The etching employs cross-hatching for texture and depth, using a monochrome palette of tan and black.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Praediorum Villarum"
artworks.artist: Hieronymus Cock (publisher)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural cartouche with Latin inscriptions. The image features a detailed and ornate cartouche design, displaying a central rectangular panel with Latin text. The frame is richly decorated with classical elements, including scrollwork, floral motifs, and masks of faces. At the top and bottom of the cartouche, fruits and leaves add a naturalistic touch. The fine lines and precise detailing suggest that the drawing is executed with great technical skill.

artworks.title: Village Road with Farm and Sheds
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point looking towards a small rural settlement. The horizon is at the top, lined with trees. The sky is plain. The artwork features detailed line work capturing the texture of trees, foliage, and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and neutral tones. A woman and child walk along a path towards buildings nestled among trees. The path continues into the distance.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a point of view that looks slightly elevated. The horizon is placed in the upper third of the composition, largely obscured by the dense growth of trees that make up the landscape. The horizon line is not sharply defined due to the abundance of trees spread across the image, with branches reaching towards the sky. The brushstrokes or etching technique used here appears delicate and intricate, with fine lines that add detail to the foliage and texture to the trees and path. The color palette is monochromatic, as the print is done in black and white. Closest to us, there are trees with detailed bark and foliage, and beyond them, a dirt path winds its way towards a small house or barn, partially obscured by trees in the middle distance, with a couple of figures standing beside the path.

artworks.title: Village Road
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a road leading to a village. Cottages and trees line the path. The brushwork is detailed with crosshatching for shadows. The color palette is sepia. In the foreground, there is a man with a dog.

artworks.title: Village Road with Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after the Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing a rural setting from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees, rooftops, and houses are depicted in delicate, fine lines with a monochromatic color palette of cream and black. Birds are seen flying above the trees.

artworks.title: Castle
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows an ink drawing of a castle in a landscape. The drawing features detailed linework of the castle and surrounding trees. A group of three figures and a dog walk on a path towards the castle.

artworks.title: Country House with a Ditch
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The scene depicts a rural landscape with a small body of water in the foreground, cows wading in the water, a cobbled path leading to a wooden gate, a farmhouse complex, trees, birds flying above, rooftops of buildings, and chimneys. The image is executed in a monochrome palette with fine lines and cross-hatching techniques, creating an engraved effect.

artworks.title: Town Gate with Country Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of an ancient, castle-like structure on the right, with multiple conical rooftops and towering walls guarding a narrow, arched bridge below. On the left, rows of buildings with steeply sloped roofs lead towards more structures and a possible town gate in the distance. Two figures walk along a pathway in the foreground, with birds flying in the sky above. The etching has sharp, linear brushstrokes, emphasizing textures and details. The color palette is monochrome, in black and various shades of gray.

artworks.title: Farms
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a group of buildings, including a tall, round tower with a thatched roof. The sky is visible with a few birds flying. The illustration uses fine linework, likely an etching technique, to depict texture and depth. The color scheme is monochrome with shades of grey and black. There is a couple walking on a dirt path in the foreground. A village near water can be seen with ducks and an upturned boat. In the background, trees and structures fade into the landscape.

artworks.title: A Farmyard with a Draw Well
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a thatched-roof barn, trees, buildings, and a bird flying in the sky. The scene is depicted in an etching style with delicate line work and a monochromatic color palette of black and gray.

artworks.title: Farms in a Court
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with rustic buildings, trees, and the sky. A large building with a steep roof is on the right, surrounded by smaller structures with pointed roofs on the left. Fine, precise lines indicate an etching technique. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia. The ground is depicted with evenly spaced lines.

artworks.title: Country Village
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky with clouds and birds flying. Village houses, trees, smaller buildings, and bare trees populate the landscape. In the foreground, a group of people converses around a bench, and another person walks across the scene. The style resembles etching, with fine lines creating textures and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia or brown ink.

artworks.title: Farmstead
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural setting with a fenced property surrounded by trees. In the background, there are several buildings, including a tall central structure with a thatched roof, alongside smaller buildings. The structures are intricately detailed with fine, linear brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey. In the foreground, there are cows resting under a tree, with human figures visible near the buildings. The sky above is partly cloudy.

artworks.title: Country Houses
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image displays a rural scene with a village setting. The horizon is higher, emphasizing a sense of depth. Rooftops of buildings can be seen amidst trees in the distance. The fine, delicate brushstrokes give a detailed and textured look. The color palette is mainly black and brown. In the foreground, a couple of figures are on a winding path, with trees directing towards the village buildings. The sky shows clouds and birds in flight.

artworks.title: Country Village with Church and Bridge
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a village across a body of water. There are buildings, trees, and a steeple on the horizon. The scene is depicted in a fine etching style with intricate details. The color scheme is monochromatic, with shades of sepia or brown. In the foreground, there is calm water, a bridge over a stream, and birds on the water.

artworks.title: Fields and a Village Road with Post Mill
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with fields, a village, trees, and houses in the distance. A windmill stands out on the right. The brushstrokes detail architectural features and textures of the fields. The color palette is sepia and black. Nearest are fields divided by hedgerows and paths, with figures, including a rider on horseback.

artworks.title: Country Village with Sheep and Sitting Shepherd
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a rural landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, giving a view of the scene. The horizon is high, with distant trees and buildings. The etching uses fine lines for realism and texture, with cross-hatched patterns for shading. In the foreground, there is an open landscape with stubs or branches. A person is in a lean-to constructing something, accompanied by pigs. A couple is walking on a path from left to right. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black, white, and gray for light and shadow. The sky has light clouds.

artworks.title: Farms in a Village
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum, the Elder and Lucas van Doetechum after Master of the Small Landscapes
artworks.description: The image shows a rural village scene with a person herding sheep, rustic houses, trees, and a cart. The artwork features detailed line work and a monochromatic color palette of gray and black. The sky is subtly depicted with horizontal lines indicating clouds.
